adn.resume_en: 22% show 3D relief/bevel (mean relief 3.5/10), 63% carry contour/rim glow (mean glow 5.2/10), 78% sit on a dark background and 76% on a gradient/atmospheric one, 15% of outlined marks use a thick (usually white) contour, 24% add particles/sparkles. Mean saturation 7.2/10, mean brightness 3.4/10, mean complexity 3.9/10. Dominant materials: neon 27%, plastic 26%, metal 10%, vinyl 9%. Dominant lettering families: monogram 49%, custom italic wordmark 25%, script 5%. Dominant palette: #FFFFFF, #000000, #FFD700, #1A1A1A, #111827.

composition: Symmetrical 1:1 layout centered on a single bold monogram or a two-tier stacked wordmark.
Monograms must occupy 60-70% of the canvas area, leaving a 15-20% margin on all sides.
Two-tier layouts must feature a bold sans-serif top line (70% width) and an overlapping script bottom line (30% width) offset to the bottom-right.
Angle of italicization or dynamic tilt must be locked between 15 and 25 degrees.
typographie: Monograms: Custom geometric sans-serif with sharp chamfered terminals, 90-degree angles, or lightning-like cuts.
Wordmarks: Heavy, condensed, bold sans-serif paired with a fluid, continuous, hand-written brush script.
Lettering must feature a metallic gradient fill or a solid white face with a soft digital glow.
grammaire: Silhouette Fusion: Integrate thematic icons (palm trees, crescent moons, lightning bolts, handguns) directly into the letter stems or negative space.
Thick White Outline: Apply a heavy, solid white outer stroke (5-10% of letter width) to separate elements from dark backgrounds.
Glow Edge: Replace standard strokes with a high-intensity emissive neon edge bloom in cyan, pink, or purple.
Material Families: Use polished chrome with sharp bevels, matte plastic with satin finishes, or fractured gold/stone textures.
Atmospheric Backgrounds: Place logos on dark, desaturated urban scenes, misty coastal views, or solid backgrounds with soft corner light leaks.
lumiere: Dual-tone metallic sheen: Cool blue light from the bottom-left paired with warm pink/purple light from the top-right.
Internal neon glow: Self-illumination radiating from the core or edges of the central emblem.
Backlit halo: Strong ambient glow casting a soft silhouette effect against dark, textured backgrounds.
etalonnage: Nocturnal Cyber: Dominant deep blues (#020817, #0A192F) with vibrant cyan (#00E5FF) and purple (#8A2BE2) accents.
Sunset Chill: Warm orange-to-brown gradients (#4A2312, #F08A75) paired with solid white (#FFFFFF).
Miami Vice: High-contrast pink (#FF4081), deep purple (#1A0010), and bright white (#FFFFFF).
effets: Neon bloom and soft atmospheric haze/smoke.
Subtle digital noise, grain, or halftone grid overlays.
Metallic reflections, sharp beveling, and soft drop shadows.
logo: Emblems must be integrated as a fused silhouette within the monogram or positioned directly above the central wordmark.
interdits: Avoid flat, unlit 2D shapes without depth, bevels, or glow effects.
Do not use complex, multi-colored vector doodles that distract from the central emblem.
Avoid thin, non-emissive outlines that fail to separate the logo from dark backgrounds.
